answer: A refundable entry stake that vests back only while grading stays clean: each identity locks 200 POA on admission, released in slices over eight epochs and only while its grades track the panel consensus. One proven fake forfeits the whole stake plus the stakes of any identity that vouched for it. An oasis of honest work earns the stake back with interest from the emission pool, while a nebula of clones pays 200 POA per head up front, and a trellis of cross-vouching collapses the moment one node is caught.
